title: 反向微影計算
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究反問題定義、最佳化設計、可製造性、穩健驗證；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: inverse problem, optimization design, manufacturability, robust validation. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 反問題定義
stages.description: 反向微影從目標晶圓輪廓求光罩，通常存在多種候選解。
stages.descriptionEn: Inverse lithography solves for masks from target wafer contours and can admit multiple solutions.

steps.title: 定義目標輪廓與可修改的光罩區
steps.titleEn: Define target contours and editable mask regions
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：反問題需先界定設計自由度。

steps.instructionEn: Define target contours and editable mask regions. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: An inverse problem requires defined design freedoms.
steps.observation: 反問題需先界定設計自由度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: An inverse problem requires defined design freedoms. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「反問題永遠只有唯一光罩解。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "The inverse problem always has one unique mask solution.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「定義目標輪廓與可修改的光罩區」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「反問題需先界定設計自由度。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「反向微影計算」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「定義目標輪廓與可修改的光罩區」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：最佳化目標降低可能產生不可製造光罩。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「黃光任務：解析度、套刻與缺陷」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：反向微影計算 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「最佳化目標降低可能產生不可製造光罩」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Inverse lithography computation as the task boundary. After reading “Define target contours and editable mask regions”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: A lower optimization objective can produce an unmanufacturable mask. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Yellow-light mission: resolution, overlay and defects”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Inverse lithography computation: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “A lower optimization objective can produce an unmanufacturable mask” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 完成「定義目標輪廓與可修改的光罩區」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Define target contours and editable mask regions", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 反問題需先界定設計自由度。
反問題永遠只有唯一光罩解。
成本下降就表示所有限制都滿足。
optionsEn: An inverse problem requires defined design freedoms.
The inverse problem always has one unique mask solution.
A lower cost proves all constraints are satisfied.
quiz.explanation: 反問題需先界定設計自由度。 反向微影從目標晶圓輪廓求光罩，通常存在多種候選解。
quiz.explanationEn: An inverse problem requires defined design freedoms. Inverse lithography solves for masks from target wafer contours and can admit multiple solutions.
